# ecp-toolkit

> The AI ECP control plane: one operator CLI (`ecp`) that mounts the
> family's kit repos through per-repo command manifests, vendors
> tag-pinned copies into consumer projects, and guards the vendor
> boundary.

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the boundary, stated as rules an agent obeys
- [docs/quickstart.md](docs/quickstart.md): from nothing to a mounted
  fleet
- [docs/how-to.md](docs/how-to.md): the tasks you repeat
- [docs/RUNBOOK.md](docs/RUNBOOK.md): the full command surface, every
  error string and its fix, and the recovery procedures
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): setup, tests, and opening a change
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): private vulnerability reporting
- [skills/ecp-toolkit/SKILL.md](skills/ecp-toolkit/SKILL.md): the skill
  for agents operating the control plane
- [LICENSE](LICENSE): Apache-2.0

## Family

The AI Engineering Control Plane (AI ECP): independent kit repos run by
rules an agent can execute. Members:

- [repo-guards](https://github.com/kylebrodeur/repo-guards): the `guv`
  repo-discipline gates
- [actions-runner](https://github.com/kylebrodeur/actions-runner): the
  `arun` local agent-pipeline runner
- [omp-rpc-cli](https://github.com/kylebrodeur/omp-rpc-cli): persistent
  `omp` RPC sessions

## Status

Implemented from the family's CLI design; not yet published to a
package registry. Facts checked 2026-10-22.
